links.outcome: Cross-center segmentation and classification performance under bidirectional external validation
links.effect: Cross-center Dice of 0.865 and 0.779, and AUC of 0.733 and 0.830, versus internal Dice 0.891 and AUC 0.948; substantial domain shift
links.quote: Bidirectional external validation revealed substantial domain shift, with cross-center Dice of 0.865 and 0.779, and AUC of 0.733 and 0.830.

links.outcome: Performance drop from dataset/domain shift between two clinical centers
links.effect: AUC fell from 0.948 internally to 0.733 and 0.830 externally; calibration ECE rose from 0.049 to 0.178-0.304.
links.quote: calibration degraded substantially under domain shift (ECE: 0.049 internally vs 0.178-0.304 externally), requiring center-specific recalibration before clinical use.

screen.reason: Pure model development and technical retrospective validation of a new multi-task deep learning architecture (MTL-LymphNet) for ultrasound segmentation and classification, without clinical workflow evaluation or deployment practice testing.
